selection.representative_metric: Outer development held-out balanced accuracy. Internal validation is used for depth selection and pruning; final evaluation seeds remain unseen until adoption is frozen.
selection.representative_policy: Use development means to select the corrected candidate; write adoption.json before evaluation. The final evaluation does not select settings.
selection.optional_candidate_adoption: Adopt only with at least 0.5 percentage point development validation balanced-accuracy improvement, or within 0.25 points with at least 20 percent fewer nodes. Correctness fixes are independently retained.
selection.stop_rule: One predeclared depth grid and one reduced-error-pruning candidate. No further candidate search without measured development benefit. Retain all initial and ablation results.
selection.inference_candidate: Compare retained-tree traversal with the equivalent DNF on complete valid Boolean inputs. Adopt only with identical predictions and at least 5 percent median batch-time reduction in development.

scope: Synthetic Boolean concepts. All algorithms share exact splits and training-only label flips. Validation selects settings. Clean held-out test examples are never used for fitting or pruning. Random-truth is an intentionally unstructured negative control, not a claim of learnable generalization.
